panels.title: Spend by skill, agent and repo (in range)
panels.description: From Claude Code's own api_request events in Loki (ADR-014), one per model request. Present only for sessions with Claude Code's telemetry on (`stdtel-install settings`, or `--native-only` with the plugin): a session without it is missing here, not free. `(no skill)` is spend outside any skill, usually most of it. A third-party plugin's skill reads `third-party` unless the detailed view is on; the warehouse's llm_request_attributed names it where stdtel saw exactly one run in that prompt.

targets.expr: sum by (skill_name, agent_name, vcs_repository_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | label_format skill_name=`{{ or .skill_name "(no skill)" }}`, agent_name=`{{ or .agent_name "(main)" }}` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No Claude Code request recorded in this range (is its telemetry on?)

panels.title: MCP calls by server and tool (in range)
panels.description: From Claude Code's own tool_result events in Loki (ADR-014). Present only for sessions with Claude Code's telemetry on (`stdtel-install settings`, or `--native-only` with the plugin). MCP server and tool names, and the skill a Skill call loaded, arrive only with the detailed view on (`stdtel-install detailed-view on`, via the stdtel-setup skill); without it they read `(hidden: detailed view off)`. The collector keeps those names and drops everything else in the call (#142).

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="mcp_tool" | label_format mcp_server_name=`{{ or .mcp_server_name "(hidden: detailed view off)" }}`, mcp_tool_name=`{{ or .mcp_tool_name "-" }}` [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No MCP call in this range

panels.title: Skills invoked (in range)
panels.description: From Claude Code's own skill_activated events in Loki (ADR-014, ADR-016 decision 3). One event per activation, however it was invoked: typed as /name (user-slash), chosen by Claude (claude-proactive), or loaded by another skill (nested-skill). A skill typed as /name makes no Skill tool call, so the earlier tool_result count missed it. Present only for sessions with Claude Code's telemetry on (`stdtel-install settings`, or `--native-only` with the plugin). Claude Code has sent a user's own skill as `custom_skill`; that row says the name was withheld. Counts activations in the range, so a long loop started earlier does not appear.

targets.expr: sum by (skill_name, invocation_trigger) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="skill_activated" | label_format skill_name=`{{ if eq .skill_name "custom_skill" }}(your own skill: name withheld by Claude Code){{ else }}{{ or .skill_name "(no name sent)" }}{{ end }}` [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No skill ran in this range

panels.title: External spend calls / h by system
panels.description: ADR-010 decision 7. Spend that happens outside the harness, reported by whatever spent it — a CLI the agent shells out to, or an MCP server calling models of its own. stdtel cannot observe this; it receives it, so an empty graph means either nothing ran or nothing is emitting, and those are different. The money is not here: cost is a Postgres figure, on the outcomes board.

defaults.noValue: No external spend reported in this range

panels.title: Prometheus active series
panels.description: Series in Prometheus's head block, including about a thousand of Prometheus's own (it scrapes itself for this panel). Spanmetrics labels are bounded (ADR-016 decision 2); steady growth past the 10,000 line means an unbounded label has crept in. Find it with `topk(10, count by (__name__) ({__name__=~".+"}))`.

panels.title: Spend by scope (in range, warehouse)
panels.description: Claude Code's request spend by the scope its prompt ran under (ADR-010), from the warehouse, the only store that joins requests to stdtel turns by prompt id (ADR-014 decision 7). `(no scope)`: the turn declared none. `(several scopes)`: the prompt's turns named more than one, so none is guessed. `(prompt joins no stdtel turn)`: requests from sessions without stdtel's hooks, or not yet loaded; kept as its own row, never folded into no scope. `share` is each row's part of the spend in range. `data_through` is the newest request the loader has stored and `data_age_hours` its age: the warehouse lags by the loader interval. Run `stdtel-doctor --json` and read `warehouse freshness` before quoting a number (ADR-015).

targets.rawSql:
-- ADR-016 decision 3 (#159): spend by the scope its prompt ran under. Only the
-- warehouse joins Claude Code's requests to stdtel's turns (ADR-014 decision 7).
-- Every row carries data_through, the newest request the loader has stored, and its age.
WITH w AS (
  SELECT max(source_max_ts) AS data_through FROM loader_run WHERE ok AND loader = 'load_requests'
),
s AS (
  SELECT CASE scope_state WHEN 'scoped'   THEN scope_name
                          WHEN 'unscoped' THEN '(no scope)'
                          WHEN 'several'  THEN '(several scopes)'
                          ELSE '(prompt joins no stdtel turn)' END AS scope,
         count(*)      AS requests,
         sum(cost_usd) AS spend_usd
  FROM llm_request_scope
  WHERE harness = 'claude-code' AND ended_at >= $__timeFrom() AND ended_at < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.scope, s.requests, s.spend_usd,
       s.spend_usd / NULLIF(sum(s.spend_usd) OVER (), 0) AS share,
       w.data_through,
       round(date_part('epoch', now() - w.data_through)::numeric / 3600, 1) AS data_age_hours
FROM s CROSS JOIN w
ORDER BY s.spend_usd DESC NULLS LAST

defaults.noValue: No Claude Code requests in the warehouse for this range
